mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the GDP is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index combined with a high federal funds rate indicates inflationary pressure and tight monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls combined with an increase in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real retail and food services sales indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the RSAFS is increasing.
